<issue>
UnboundLocalError in _import_string function when processing import statements

#### Description

When trying to convert AST nodes to string representation, an UnboundLocalError occurs in the `_import_string` function. The error happens when processing import statements that contain aliases.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
import astroid

# This will trigger the error
code = "from astroid import modutils"
ast = astroid.parse(code)
print(ast.as_string())
```

The error also occurs with more complex import statements:

```python
import astroid

code = "from astroid.nodes.node_classes import Name as NameNode"
ast = astroid.parse(code)
print(ast.as_string())  # UnboundLocalError
```

#### Expected behavior

The `as_string()` method should return the original import statement as a string without errors.

#### Actual behavior

```
UnboundLocalError: cannot access local variable '_names' where it is not defined
```

This affects any code that tries to convert import nodes back to their string representation, breaking functionality that depends on the `as_string()` method for import statements.
</issue>
